_readme: Owner-editable news sources, read at runtime by the desk-news edge function.
general: RSS/Atom feeds shown to everyone — add/remove/reorder freely.
perTicker: feeds looked up for each held symbol (Yahoo first, Google
News as fallback, then plain text-matching of tickers in general
headlines). Set enabled:false to run general feeds only.
maxItems caps the rendered list. Edit on GitHub; desk-news re-reads
this file on its next sweep once Pages has redeployed.
CNBC: the www.cnbc.com/id/100003114/device/rss/rss.html address answers
servers 403 (Access Denied), so CNBC never appeared in the panel; the
same Top News feed on search.cnbc.com answers (checked 2026-10-11).
Majority CNBC (owner 2026-10-11): four CNBC sections (Top News 100003114,
Finance 10000664, Investing 15839069, Earnings 15839135) all labelled
CNBC, and maxItems 30. The list is newest-first across every feed, so
the share follows how much each source publishes: measured on a Sunday
(the slowest day) CNBC was 20 of the top 30; weekdays run higher. It is
not guaranteed: rows for held STOCK tickers (perTicker) rank ahead of
every general feed and take slots first, so an account holding several
stocks shows less CNBC (none today: the live panel carries no ticker
rows). A reserved share needs a per-source cap in desk-news (a deploy).
desk-news allows at most 8 general feeds.
FRED + St. Louis Fed carry the macro headlines that used to sit in the
embedded FRED widget, retired 2026-08-07 along with the TradingView
economic calendar. Holdings rank first, so these fill the tail.
